collate_DataContainer_cpu_only: collate a batch of DataContainer objects marked as cpu_only for metadata without stacking
collate_DataContainer_stack_tensors: collate a batch of DataContainer tensors with stack enabled into a single stacked tensor
collate_DataContainer_pad_dims: collate a batch of DataContainer tensors with pad_dims to pad varying shapes before stacking
collate_batch_of_mappings: collate a batch of dictionary mappings by recursively collating values under each key
collate_batch_of_sequences: collate a batch of sequence lists by transposing and recursively collating each grouped element
